summary.text: Kimberly New is a Republican state representative from Georgia House District 40 who has served in the House since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a business owner who co-owns a business and has led the Georgia Independent Automobile Dealers Association.

paragraphs.text: New lives in Villa Rica, Georgia.

Her career experience includes co-owning a business, and she has served as president and a board member of the Georgia Independent Automobile Dealers Association and as president of Epsilon Sigma Alpha (ESA) - Georgia State Council.
New won the 2022 general election for Georgia House District 64, defeating Democrat Montenia Edwards, and won the 2024 general election for District 40 against the same opponent.
Ballotpedia lists her as assuming office for District 40 on January 13, 2025, and she advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.

For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the House Appropriations Committee, the Intragovernmental Coordination Committee and the Natural Resources and Environment Committee, and she is vice chair of the Public Safety and Homeland Security Committee.
